How offline sync works in Acme 4.0

CRDTs, a write-ahead log and a lot of patience.

Sophie Tan
1 October 20268 min read
Share

Sync is the feature nobody notices until it fails. Our goal for 4.0 was simple to state and hard to build: never lose a keystroke, online or off.

Why CRDTs

A conflict-free replicated data type lets two devices edit the same document without a server deciding who wins. Every operation commutes - merging becomes a set union.

The best sync is the one you forget is there.

Hannah Lee, Design
